body: Let me share my thoughts. I've reviewed the code. The core code is right here: I believe the developer intended to insert an empty item, not a copy item. The current functionality is the result of a mistake. The insert function is implemented this way: When you click “Insert New Before”, the program will execute `properties_as_array.insert`. A new `Dictionary()` will be used to add as new item. Inside the function, use `memmove` to push the current item and later items back, then use `memnew_placement` to replace the current item with the new item. But the new item is an empty `Dictionary` without any kv pair, so it can't cover the current item. The current item and later items are pushed, but the current item is not covered, so you get a copy item. If I change the code, give `properties_as_array.insert` a `Dictionary` with zero values, the “Insert New Before” button and the “Insert New After” button can insert empty items correctly. ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3a5f2a41-8dbb-435f-9cf4-454520c1db7f) The code is developed by @groud in #52277. CC @groud. If I'm right, I will create a PR.
